verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a project or space feature that groups chats and files under shared context and instructions. The closest items are different capabilities. Kimi Code Desktop opens a local code folder for an agent. Platform 'projects' are organizational units for API keys, budgets and billing. Memory and file Q&A are listed separately but never tied to a shared workspace.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
